_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoked: Request sent to a Domus Aedes advisor
_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Sending your request to Domus Aedes…

description: Sends the person's contact details and message about a property (or a general brief) to a Domus Aedes advisor, who replies by email or WhatsApp. Requires name, email and a message; phone is optional.

email.description: The person's own email address, where the team replies

intent.description: What the enquiry is about: buy = purchase · rent = long-term monthly let · stay = short-term holiday stay

language.description: Language the person writes in: en, es or fr. The team replies in it. Default en

message.description: What the person wants to know or do

name.description: The person's full name, as they gave it

phone.description: Phone or WhatsApp number with country code, if the person gave one

ref.description: Property reference the message is about, if any

name: request_property_details
title: Request details from an advisor
